title: Discover Your Dream Home at Rustomjee Urban Woods
author: Housiey
contentHtml:
If you're looking for the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, Rustomjee Urban Woods in Dombivli East, Mumbai is the ideal choice. With its thoughtfully designed residences, excellent connectivity, and world-class amenities, this residential project offers everything you need to build your dream life. Whether you're searching for a property for sale to invest in or a home to settle down, Rustomjee Urban Woods presents an unmissable opportunity.

Why Buy Property in Dombivli East?

Dombivli East is rapidly emerging as one of Mumbai’s prime residential locations, offering a mix of urban infrastructure, green surroundings, and affordability. Here’s why you should buy property in Dombivli East:

  • Seamless Connectivity: Well-connected to Thane, Navi Mumbai, and Mumbai via major roadways and rail networks.
  • Upcoming Infrastructure Developments: Enhanced connectivity with metro expansion and new road projects.
  • Thriving Social Infrastructure: Schools, hospitals, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs within easy reach.
  • Rapid Appreciation: A promising real estate market with high investment potential.

Unit Configurations and Carpet Areas

Rustomjee Urban Woods offers a range of beautifully designed apartments catering to different family sizes and preferences. The project features 1BHK, 2BHK, and 3BHK homes, each with spacious interiors and premium fittings. Here’s a breakdown of the available unit configurations:

  • 1 BHK Apartments – Carpet area: 495 sqft
  • 2 BHK Apartments – Carpet area: 590 sqft to 667 sqft
  • 3 BHK Apartments – Carpet area: 890 sqft to 963 sqft

Each unit is designed to maximize space utilization while offering a perfect blend of aesthetics and functionality.

The floor plans at Rustomjee Urban Woods are crafted to provide maximum comfort and efficiency. Each apartment boasts a well-ventilated layout, ample natural light, and smart space management. The 1BHK units are ideal for young professionals and small families, while the 2BHK and 3BHK units cater to growing families looking for additional space and comfort.

Key Features of the Floor Plans:

  • Efficient Space Utilization: Smartly designed layouts that enhance functionality and comfort.
  • Large Windows and Balconies: Ensure ample ventilation and stunning views of the surroundings.
  • Well-Defined Living Areas: Dedicated spaces for living, dining, and bedrooms to provide a seamless living experience.
  • Modern Kitchens & Bathrooms: Contemporary fittings and high-quality materials for a luxurious touch.

Prime Location Advantages of Rustomjee Urban Woods

One of the biggest advantages of Rustomjee Urban Woods is its strategic location in Dombivli East. With excellent connectivity and proximity to key landmarks, residents enjoy easy access to essential services and recreational hubs.

  • Road Connectivity: Well-connected via Kalyan-Shilphata Road, Mumbai-Pune Expressway, and Eastern Express Highway.

  • Healthcare Facilities: Multi-specialty hospitals and clinics in close proximity.
  • Shopping & Entertainment: Malls, supermarkets, and multiplexes within easy reach.
  • Upcoming Infrastructure: Proposed metro expansion and infrastructure projects enhancing the area’s real estate value.
